data.title: Appointment confirmation – passport application (Musterstadt Bürgeramt)
data.summary: The Bürgeramt of Stadt Musterstadt confirms an appointment for Mara Beispiel to apply for a passport on 12 May 2026 at 9:30 in Bürgeramt Mitte, counter 4, with a fee of €70.
data.explanation: This letter confirms your appointment to apply for a new passport (Reisepass). Bring your current ID, a recent biometric passport photo, and the €70 fee (card payment accepted) to the appointment. If you cannot make it, cancel the appointment online beforehand so the slot can be given to someone else. No other action is needed before the appointment date.
